crop.notes: Full sporting column (Corbett/Donovan, Goddard, Burge, Pugilistic Pointers); Allen appears only in the 'A Well Known St. Louis Pugilist' item about Dublin Tricks in crops 3-4

title.suggested: Dublin Tricks, Trainer of McCoole and Gallagher

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch profiled William Blake, known as Dublin Tricks, who trained Mike McCoole and Charlie Gallagher; it noted Gallagher met Tom Allen twice, defeating him the first time.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Tuesday, September 20, 1892, page 12

facts.fact: Charlie Gallagher fought Allen twice, defeating him the first time; Gallagher was trained by William Blake (Dublin Tricks)

notes: Current title wrongly implies Dublin Tricks trained Allen; he trained Allen's opponents McCoole and Gallagher.
